name: Witch Doctor: Umbral Glaive takes over every Hex of Malice button quietly and hands each back its own rank (#5761)
contract: The Umbral Glaive buff 504588 makes AscensionWitchDoctor::SyncReplacements replace every known Hex of Malice rank with Umbral Glaive 501134 through Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement, and the buff's end hands them back. The swap used to reach the client as one SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL per rank, which the client answers with a 'You have learned a new spell' chat line each time (#1506), and the reverts arrived in map order, so a button could come back holding rank 2 instead of the rank it had (#5761). With CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.Silent on, no superseded-spell packet is sent: the server writes the replacement into every button holding a Hex rank, records which rank each button held, resends the bar, and on revert restores each button's own rank. Umbral Glaive stays in the client's spellbook once taught, and the server refuses casting it outside its swap. The client prints no line for any of it, and the saved bar never holds the temporary spell.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle

Let the throttled sync run again
No superseded-spell packet is sent for the swap

The client's rank 2 button carries Umbral Glaive
The client's rank 1 button carries Umbral Glaive

The rank 6 button is saved as rank 6, never as the temporary spell
The rank 2 button is saved as rank 2

Nothing printed a line for Umbral Glaive
Nothing printed a line for Hex of Malice
The rank 6 button gets rank 6 back (#5761)
The rank 2 button gets rank 2 back
The rank 1 button gets rank 1 back
The server's copy of the bar holds rank 6 again
